Pree, it's **Pine Crossing**. On 9 June you posted in this channel that the morning receiver at Pine Crossing said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver had arrived at 7:10 the day before, and they wrote his trailer number on a sticky note.

That's the only name I found for the site. Nothing I can see gives it a site code or address. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and have support test it with the store login, but I don't see a follow-up on that here.

Don't mix it up with Salina North (Bay 4) in the January handoff note. That one belongs to Marrow Fieldworks, a different account.
